content.text: {"predictors": [{"name": "Supplier Concentration Fragility", "construction": "From 10-K MD&A and note disclosures, count the number of named major suppliers accounting for >10% of cost of goods sold. Construct a Herfindahl-style concentration index of disclosed supplier dependence, scaled by COGS/total assets. Rank firms cross-sectionally each June using the most recent annual filing.", "rationale": "Firms dependent on few suppliers face uninsurable input-disruption risk that is slow to be priced, commanding a risk premium once supply-chain fragility materializes.", "higher_returns_for": "high supplier concentration"}, {"name": "Order Backlog Growth Acceleration", "construction": "Using Compustat item order backlog (OB), compute the second difference of log backlog scaled by sales over the trailing four annual reports (acceleration = current backlog growth minus prior-year backlog growth). Rank firms with reported backlog each June.", "rationale": "Accelerating backlog signals demand momentum that analysts underweight relative to earnings, generating underreaction and subsequent positive drift.", "higher_returns_for": "high backlog growth acceleration"}, {"name": "Intraday Range Compression", "construction": "For each stock, compute the average daily (high-low)/close range over the prior 60 trading days, then divide by the same range measured over the prior 250 days. Values below 1 indicate volatility compression. Rank cross-sectionally monthly.", "rationale": "Compressed intraday ranges reflect building latent uncertainty and reduced liquidity provision, which precede volatility expansion and demand a premium.", "higher_returns_for": "low range compression ratio (most compressed)"}, {"name": "Deferred Revenue Momentum", "construction": "From quarterly balance sheets, compute the year-over-year growth in deferred/unearned revenue (Compustat DRC/DRLT) scaled by total assets, using the four most recent quarters. Rank firms with nonzero deferred revenue monthly following the earnings filing.", "rationale": "Rising deferred revenue is a leading indicator of future recognized sales and cash flows that is under-scrutinized versus headline earnings, causing predictable drift.", "higher_returns_for": "high deferred revenue growth"}, {"name": "Capex Timing Asymmetry", "construction": "Compute the ratio of fourth-quarter capital expenditures to full-year capital expenditures (from quarterly cash-flow statements). Firms concentrating investment in Q4 score high. Rank annually each March.", "rationale": "Year-end concentrated capex reflects opportunistic, less-disciplined budget-exhausting spending associated with weaker future returns on investment.", "higher_returns_for": "low Q4 capex concentration"}, {"name": "Analyst Coverage Dispersion Decay", "construction": "Using I/B/E/S, measure the change in the standard deviation of analyst long-term growth forecasts over the trailing 6 months, scaled by consensus growth. Negative values (converging opinions) rank high. Update monthly.", "rationale": "Converging analyst opinions signal resolving uncertainty and declining ambiguity risk, which is followed by positive returns as disagreement-based discounts unwind.", "higher_returns_for": "large decline in forecast dispersion"}, {"name": "Working Capital Efficiency Shock", "construction": "Compute the cash conversion cycle (days inventory + days receivable - days payable) from quarterly data, then measure its year-over-year change. Firms with large improvements (declines) rank high. Update after each quarterly filing.", "rationale": "Sudden improvements in working-capital efficiency reveal operational discipline and free cash generation that markets are slow to capitalize.", "higher_returns_for": "large improvement (decline) in cash conversion cycle"}, {"name": "Debt Maturity Wall Proximity", "construction": "From long-term debt maturity schedules in 10-K notes, compute the fraction of total debt maturing within the next 24 months, scaled by trailing operating cash flow. Rank firms annually each March.", "rationale": "A near-term maturity wall relative to internal cash generation embeds refinancing risk that commands a premium when credit conditions are uncertain.", "higher_returns_for": "high near-term maturity share relative to cash flow"}, {"name": "Employee Productivity Trend", "construction": "Compute sales per employee (Compustat SALE/EMP) and measure its three-year compound growth rate. Rank firms with reported employee counts each June.", "rationale": "Sustained gains in labor productivity reflect improving operating leverage and competitive advantage that are underpriced due to the low salience of headcount data.", "higher_returns_for": "high sales-per-employee growth"}, {"name": "Return Seasonality Persistence", "construction": "For each stock, compute the average return in the same calendar month over the prior five years, then form the cross-sectional rank of this historical same-month average each month. Trade the stocks with the highest historical same-month returns.", "rationale": "Firm-specific seasonal patterns in cash flows and information releases recur but are neglected by investors focused on recent overall performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high historical same-calendar-month average return"}]}
